nodes.label: ABAC Default-Deny + Deny-Overrides-Allow
nodes.rationale: No matching policy = deny; a single deny overrides all allows; RLS remains mandatory as defense-in-depth even when ABAC already checked; high-risk denials are logged to a decision log.

nodes.label: ADR-0025 Scope Note (ERP modules not ported)
nodes.rationale: Several AccessAction literals (retire/reassign/force_decide, commit/rollback, void/reclassify/reserve) are generic seams retained from the upstream awcms-mini contract for ERP modules (workflow_approval, reference_data, document_infrastructure) that are NOT ported to AWCMS-Micro (website scope) — the union stays intact as a generic contract but consumers are downstream ERP apps, not this base.
